jobs.title: Senior Director, Platform
jobs.description:
About Miovision: 
 At Miovision, we’re unlocking transportation networks that move you. Our vision and mission is to enable smart, fast, safe communities that simply flow, as we drive the Intelligent Mobility Revolution. Backed by the world’s most advanced traffic AI, Miovision’s innovations in traffic signal planning and operations are making it possible for cities to improve the transportation experience for drivers, cyclists and pedestrians.

Our values drive us. They’re at the core of everything we do. If they align with yours, proceed through the GREEN light!
 All in to win: We're driven by a winning mindset, approaching every challenge with intensity, clarity, and speed.

 One Miovision: We succeed as one team, uniting diverse talents, building on trust, and putting our shared mission before ego.

 Be better every day: We're committed to continuous growth, staying curious, building mastery, and embracing challenges as learning opportunities.

 Make it happen: We are proactive and results-driven, taking ownership, acting with urgency, and focusing on solutions that deliver real impact.

 Earn the customer: We are deeply customer-centric, focused on earning our customers' partnership every day by delivering exceptional experiences that drive their success.

 Position Summary: 
 At Miovision, we are engineering the future of smart transportation, and right now, we are laying down the asphalt for our most ambitious infrastructure project yet. We are building a governed, API-first technology platform that will act as the ultimate express lane for how we build software, enabling new experiences for customers, partners, and AI agents. We are looking for a Senior Director, Platform to serve as the master traffic controller for this massive transformation. Reporting to the SVP of Software Engineering & Technology, you will build the foundational highways that our entire product ecosystem travels on. You will steer our engineering organization away from gridlocked, application-centric development and into a high-speed, contract-driven future. If you are a hands-on leader ready to pave the way for AI-assisted innovation and ensure our platform capabilities always get the green light, it is time to take the wheel!

 Objectives and Responsibilities: 
 Platform Strategy & Architectural Foundation 
 Own the engineering strategy and translate our Platform North Star into clear architectural priorities for both human and AI-driven use cases.

 Spearhead the transition from application-centric integration toward a governed, contract-driven, API-first platform.

 Partner with Architecture to establish a durable technical foundation that protects long-term integrity while pragmatically supporting near-term delivery.

 Drive an engineering culture where teams naturally build on the platform because it is the absolute fastest and most effective path to delivering value.

 Organizational Leadership & Scaling 
 Lead, coach, and aggressively grow the Platform Engineering organization by recruiting top-tier talent with deep expertise in APIs, distributed systems, and AI.

 Build a highly resilient team culture grounded in ownership, curiosity, technical excellence, and high-velocity delivery.

 Lead the shift toward platform-first ways of working, building alignment, adoption, and accountability across the broader Engineering department.

 Create an environment where senior engineers are highly empowered to make decisions while remaining perfectly aligned with a shared architectural direction.

 Platform as a Product (First-Party, Third-Party & Ecosystem Enablement) 
 Partner with Product Leadership to operate the Platform exactly like a customer-facing product, treating internal developers, external partners, and AI agents as your core customers.

 Establish API contracts as first-class products that natively support authentication, observability, usage metering, and scalable commercial models from day one.

 Build a governed, unified entry point for Miovision's strategic capabilities, utilizing adoption data and developer feedback to continuously improve the ecosystem.

 Identify and build reusable, standardized capabilities—partnering with Data Science to integrate models and data products—eliminating isolated alternatives across the company.

 Technical Leadership & Hands-On Builder 
 Remain deeply engaged in the technology—reviewing architecture, exploring code, and prototyping solutions alongside your engineers to blast through ambiguity.

 Build the technical foundations for AI-assisted development, personally utilizing modern agentic tools and establishing AI-native practices across your team.

 Partner with Developer Operations to build automation and tooling that makes standardized, scalable architecture the absolute easiest path for our engineers.

 Bring razor-sharp technical judgment to complex distributed systems, helping teams practically evolve existing architecture without requiring massive, disruptive rewrites.

 Operational Excellence, Reliability & Trust 
 Establish world-class reliability, observability, security, and operational readiness as the fundamental DNA of all Platform capabilities.

 Ensure human and agent identity, delegated authorization, auditability, and guardrails are natively built into the platform rather than siloed across individual teams.

 Define strict lifecycle, compatibility, and service health standards so consumers can depend on Platform services with absolute confidence.

 Ensure the Platform seamlessly scales alongside Miovision’s rapidly growing products, customer base, and engineering organization without multiplying operational complexity.

 The Ideal Profile: 
 The Engineering Veteran: You bring 15+ years of software engineering experience with a heavy focus on platform engineering, distributed systems, and large-scale architecture.

 The Organization Builder: You have a proven track record of successfully leading, scaling, and coaching senior engineering teams in highly complex, multi-product environments.

 The API Architect: You boast deep technical expertise in API design, microservices, contract governance, and full API lifecycle management.

 The Platform Product Thinker: You treat platforms exactly like a product. Experience monetizing a platform, scaling a marketplace, or building a third-party developer ecosystem is strongly preferred.

 The AI-Native Leader: You have hands-on experience executing platform strategies that fundamentally change how engineering teams use AI to build, verify, and deliver software (including exposure to MCP and machine-readable interfaces).

 The Hands-On Builder: You are a highly credible technical leader who is just as comfortable exploring code and prototyping a solution as you are driving an executive strategy meeting.

 The Cloud Heavyweight: You have deep, practical familiarity with cloud-native architectures (AWS), Kubernetes, modern CI/CD, and languages like Java, Python, or Node.js.

 The Transformation Driver: You have demonstrated experience successfully driving massive architectural or engineering operating-model shifts within an organization.

 The Operations Sentinel: You possess a profound understanding of reliability, telemetry, security, and operational excellence in massive, high-stakes production systems.

 The Strategic Diplomat: You wield excellent communication and influence skills, capable of partnering flawlessly with Product Management, Architecture, and C-suite stakeholders.

 The Pragmatic Visionary: You excel at systems thinking—perfectly balancing the need for long-term architectural integrity with the reality of pragmatic, incremental delivery.

 Your Rewards & Well-being: 
We invest in our team with benefits designed for modern life and true work-life balance.
 Comprehensive Coverage: Your well-being is covered from day one with comprehensive health benefits, 24/7 virtual healthcare access, and dedicated wellness programs.

 Financial Future: Build for tomorrow with our RRSP/401K Matching Plan and share in the company's success through our Variable Incentive Plan.

 Time to Recharge: Truly unplug with our unique Mio-Days and flexible vacation policy.

 Work & Life Support: We support you with flexible work options, an internet subsidy, a remote work allowance, and enhanced leave for new parents.

 Sound like your next adventure? Apply now and let's start building together! 
 We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Please indicate if you require accommodation on your application, and our team will work with you to meet your accessibility needs.
 Miovision may use artificial intelligence (AI) to assist in the hiring process for tasks such as helping to identify qualified candidates, taking meeting notes, creating summaries, and streamlining administrative work. These tools are one of several factors considered in the hiring process and do not replace human judgement. We do not use AI to make any final hiring or interview decisions. 
 PLEASE BE AWARE OF FRAUD: Applicants interested in applying for roles at Miovision should apply directly via the details provided on our careers page. We communicate directly with applicants and will not request banking information, payment, or fees during any point of the recruitment process. We do not conduct interviews via text message. If you suspect that a third party is impersonating Miovision or requesting payment for recruitment on behalf of Miovision, please alert us via recruitment@miovision.com.
 To all recruitment agencies: Miovision does not accept agency solicitation or resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our HR alias e-mail address, to any Miovision employee, or to other Miovision e-mail addresses. Miovision will not pay any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

jobs.title: Director, Data Architecture & Information Management
jobs.description:
Who We Are 

 At Momentum Financial Services Group, we help people move forward by reimagining how money works for those who need it most. With more than 40 years of experience, we’re the team behind Money Mart—Canada’s largest non-bank branch network—and a leader in financial solutions for underserved communities.

 From short-term loans to money transfers and prepaid cards, we power the products, technology, and operations that connect over a million customers a year to the money they need, when they need it.

 At MFSG, we come together across teams and departments to create something bigger than ourselves: solutions that remove barriers and give people access to money they might not get anywhere else. Whether you're solving problems, building systems, or shaping strategy, your work fuels real support for real people.

 We’ve Got You Covered 

 Compensation Philosophy: Our strategy is designed to attract and retain top talent by offering competitive, fair, and performance-driven rewards. We benchmark against the market, recognize strong performance and continuously evolve to meet the needs of our people and our business.

 Discretionary Annual Bonus: Enjoy the opportunity for a discretionary bonus based on individual performance and company success.

 Comprehensive Benefits: Our benefits include health and dental plans with 100% of the premiums covered. We also offer an Employee Assistance Program to support your mental well-being and provide resources for personal challenges.

 Retirement Plans: Plan for your future with our robust retirement savings options, ensuring you’re set for the long haul.

 Hybrid Work Environment: Experience the best of both worlds with our hybrid work model, allowing you to balance remote work with in-office.

 Perks and Rewards: Enjoy reimbursement for tuition assistance and professional development, discounts through Perkopolis and participate in our rewards and recognition programs to celebrate your contributions.

 What You’ll Do 

 The Job:  Director, Data Architecture & Information Management

 As the  Director, Data Architecture & Information Management, you will serve as the organization’s designated authority and strategic leader for enterprise data architecture. Working across major business and technology initiatives, you will influence key decisions and lead the evolution of the enterprise data systems architecture, enterprise data model, and Master Data Management (MDM) capabilities.

 This leadership role is accountable for setting the strategic direction for data and establishing the standards, patterns, information models, and architecture review processes that govern how data is designed, integrated, and managed across the enterprise. Through this work, you will enable trusted, scalable, and reusable information assets that support business operations, analytics, digital initiatives, and AI capabilities.

 What You’ll Do 

 Provide architectural leadership and design oversight across major projects, programs, and technology initiatives that impact enterprise data.

 Partner with business and technology leaders to define future-state data capabilities and architecture roadmaps aligned with strategic priorities.

 Define and lead the organization’s Master Data Management (MDM) strategy, architecture, and roadmap, beginning with customer data and expanding across additional domains.

 Own and evolve the enterprise canonical data model and business information architecture to improve consistency, interoperability, reuse, and scalability.

 Establish and govern enterprise data architecture standards, design patterns, information models, reference architectures, and architecture review processes.

 Lead enterprise data modeling, metadata architecture, information lifecycle management, and related architectural practices.

 Evaluate emerging technologies, data platforms, and AI capabilities to strengthen the enterprise data architecture and create business value.

 Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of Data Architects, Data Modelers, and Data Engineers..

 What You’ll Bring 

 Required Qualifications 

 Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Management, or a related discipline.

 10+ years of progressive experience in enterprise data architecture, information architecture, data modeling, and information management.

 Proven success influencing enterprise-wide business and technology decisions through architectural leadership.

 Experience partnering with Enterprise, Solution, and Cloud Architects to establish end-to-end architecture strategies.

 Demonstrated experience designing and implementing enterprise data standards, architecture patterns, and governance processes.

 Strong expertise in conceptual, logical, and physical data modeling.

 Experience leading Master Data Management (MDM) initiatives and enterprise information management programs.

 Experience developing enterprise information models, integration standards, and reference architectures.

 Proven ability to collaborate with senior business and technology leaders to define future-state architecture roadmaps.

 Preferred Qualifications 

 Master’s degree in a related discipline.

 Experience within financial services or another highly regulated industry.

 Experience designing or supporting modern cloud-based data platforms, preferably Snowflake.

 Experience with modern data transformation and modeling practices using dbt or similar technologies.

 Experience enabling AI, advanced analytics, customer intelligence, and digital transformation initiatives.

 Experience building and leading architecture or information management teams.

 Committed to Equal Opportunity: 

 MFSG is committed to accommodating applicants up to the point of undue hardship during the recruitment, assessment and selection process. If you are selected for an interview, please notify MFSG if you require accommodation in respect of the materials or procedures used at any time during this process. If you require accommodation, MFSG will work with you to determine how to meet your needs.
  

 About MFSG – Our Commitment to Responsible Innovation

 At MFSG, we are committed to building innovative solutions grounded in ethical, transparent, and responsible use of data and technology. Aligned with the principles outlined in Canada’s Artificial Intelligence and Data Act (AIDA), we take a proactive approach to ensuring that any AI or data-driven systems we use are safe, fair, and accountable.

Director, Quantitative Data Products 

 Nasdaq's Alternative Data group specializes in creating unique and insightful data products from non-traditional data sources. Well-known examples of Alternative Data include sentiment measures, real-time tracking of vehicles via GPS transponders, satellite monitoring of industrial facilities, and consumer insights gleaned from anonymized credit card transactions. Our data products empower some of the world's most sophisticated investment funds to outperform. 

 As Director of Quantitative Data Products, you'll play a critical role in defining strategy and driving execution of a portfolio of innovative Alternative Data products. You'll thrive in this position if you're entrepreneurial, data-driven, and strategic, with a deep understanding of investments and a passion for creating products that generate real business impact in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. The ideal candidate has trade floor and/or investments experience, with a strong understanding of buy-side and sell-side trading workflows. 

 Key Responsibilities 
 Conduct market research and engage directly with clients to identify new product opportunities and validate concepts.

 Own the full product lifecycle from ideation and validation through launch, scale, and ongoing optimization.

 Develop and prioritize product roadmaps that align with business objectives and drive measurable revenue growth.

 Partner with cross-functional teams including data science, data engineering, partnerships, client success, sales, and marketing to design and deliver innovative data products.

 Drive go-to-market strategy, including pricing, positioning, and sales enablement to maximize product adoption and success.

 Required Qualifications 
 10+ years of experience in product management, product development, and/or data analysis within the investment industry.

 Deep understanding of capital markets, data product fundamentals, and data feeds/products.

 Proven ability to conceptualize and drive new initiatives from 0-to-1 in a fast-paced and entrepreneurial environment.

 Excellent communicator with strong stakeholder management skills and a revenue-focused, owner mindset.

 Bachelor's degree in finance, economics, computer science, engineering, or related discipline.

 Preferred Qualifications 
 Strong understanding of the alternative data landscape, including key companies and products/services, as well as their competitive positioning.

 Experienced in evaluating and applying alternative data to the investment lifecycle (i.e., programming, statistics, backtesting, etc).

 0-to-1 startup or venture-building experience.

 This position will be located in Toronto and offers the opportunity for a hybrid work environment at least 3 days a week in-office, subject to change, providing flexibility and accessibility for qualified candidates.

 Come as You Are 

 Nasdaq is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and identities.

 We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where diverse perspectives, experiences, and identities are valued and celebrated.

 We ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation throughout the hiring process.

 What We Offer 

 We’re proud to offer a competitive rewards package that is meaningful, recognizes the unique needs of our employees and their families and incentivizes employees for their contribution to Nasdaq’s overall success.

The base pay range for this role is $121,000 - $170,000. In addition to base salary, Nasdaq provides a generous annual bonus/commission (short-term incentive), and equity (long-term incentive), comprehensive benefits, and opportunity for growth. Exact compensation may vary based on several job-related factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to: skill set, experience, education/training, business needs and market demands.

Job Description 

 Director of Solution Architecture, Capital Markets
 WHAT IS THE OPPORTUNITY? 

 As Head of Data Architecture, you will lead the strategic design and governance of RBC Capital Market's data platform ecosystem. This high-impact leadership role shapes how the organization captures, stores, processes, and leverages data to drive business value. You'll oversee architecture of critical systems supporting capital markets operations, guide teams through data modernization initiatives, and establish standards that enable innovation while maintaining integrity and security. Partner with senior business and technology leaders to deliver transformational outcomes and influence enterprise-wide technology decisions.
 WHAT WILL YOU DO? 
 Consult on major initiatives within CM (Capital Markets) to help design solutions that meet the specific needs of the delivery while also progressing the broader architectural strategy of the department (align with architecture principles, modernize and simplify the estate, re-use capabilities/technologies, etc).

 Review proposed architectures from CM delivery teams to align specific team requirements to high level goals of CM leadership and the bank.  For instance, why are you ordering a physical machine instead of using internal cloud?  Why are you using Redis over MemSQL?  Why are you pulling X from RBCAppA instead of RBCAppB?  Etc..

 Help lead an architecture council in which proposed architectures are debated for their merits and scrutinized by a broad set of stakeholders. 

 Help to form and communicate technology guidance to standardize development of commonly needed capabilities.  For instance, figure out what our API strategy should be, document it on confluence, present it to senior leadership, and show dev teams how to implement it.

 WHAT DO YOU NEED TO SUCCEED? 

 Must have 
 • Undergraduate degree coupled with transformational experience in complex programs with and multiple priorities and stakeholders
 • Demonstrated ability in written and oral communication skills along with strong presentation skills; ability to determine the information and communication needs of stakeholders and projects.

 What is the opportunity? 
 RBC has embarked on a transformational journey leveraging Generative AI and AI as a catalyst to drive significant productivity gains and revenue growth across the enterprise. We are seeking an exceptional, strategic leader to serve as Director of AI & Digital Transformation Programs, playing a pivotal role in shaping and executing RBC's most critical AI initiatives.

 As a Director within the RBC AI Group, you will lead the strategic direction and execution of enterprise-wide AI Transformation programs. You will serve as a trusted advisor to senior executives, orchestrating cross-functional collaboration across business lines, technology, risk, finance, and compliance. Reporting to executive leadership, you will be accountable for delivering measurable business impact while navigating complex organizational dynamics and driving cultural change across the bank.

 Your responsibilities will include: 
 Define and drive enterprise AI strategy: Partner with senior executives and business leaders to shape, structure, and prioritize AI programs that deliver measurable bottom-line impact and align with RBC's strategic objectives

 Lead complex, enterprise-scale transformations: Support the planning, governance, and execution of multiple large-scale AI programs with interdependencies across platforms, business units, and geographies

 Partner with business lines to execute transformational AI programs: Collaborate closely with business leaders across Personal & Commercial Banking, Wealth Management, Capital Markets, Insurance, and other key segments to co-design and deliver AI solutions that transform operations, enhance customer experiences, and drive revenue growth

 Build strategic partnerships and influence at the executive level: Establish and maintain executive-level relationships across Finance, Risk, Compliance, Technology, Procurement, and Business Units to secure alignment, funding, and support for AI initiatives

 Drive organizational change and adoption: Design and execute change management strategies to accelerate AI adoption, embedding new ways of working and ensuring sustainable transformation

 Provide executive counsel and thought leadership: Lead storytelling in executive forums through compelling presentations, business cases, and strategic communications that drive informed decision-making and maintain stakeholder confidence

 Optimize enterprise processes for AI delivery: Partner with senior leaders to streamline governance, risk, compliance, and procurement frameworks, enabling faster, more efficient deployment of AI solutions

 Manage risk and resolve strategic blockers: Proactively identify program risks, dependencies, and organizational impediments; escalate strategically to executive leadership to drive resolution and maintain momentum

 Develop and mentor program leadership: Build and guide a team of program managers, fostering a high-performance culture focused on delivery excellence and continuous improvement

 You're our ideal candidate if you: 
 Must-have:
 8+ years of progressive experience in strategy, digital transformation, management consulting, or financial services leadership roles

 Proven track record leading large-scale, enterprise-wide transformation programs with demonstrated business impact

 Deep expertise in artificial intelligence, machine learning, and emerging digital technologies, with the ability to translate technical concepts for executive audiences

 Executive presence and influence: Exceptional ability to build credibility, influence decision-making, and navigate complex stakeholder environments at the senior executive and SVP levels

 Strategic thinking and business acumen: Strong capability to connect technology initiatives to business outcomes, ROI, and strategic priorities

 Mastery of program and change management: Expert-level skills in managing integrated programs, dependencies, governance structures, and organizational change at scale

 Outstanding communication and storytelling: Proven ability to craft and deliver executive-level presentations, business cases, and strategic narratives that drive action

 Relationship building across matrix organizations: Demonstrated success building and leveraging partnerships across complex, matrixed organizations

 Nice-to-have:
 Advanced degree (MBA, Master's in relevant field)

 Prior experience leading AI/ML or data-driven transformation initiatives

 Background in consulting or corporate strategy roles

 What's in it for you: 
 Lead AI transformation at one of Canada's largest and most respected financial institutions, with direct visibility to Group Head and Operating Committee level leadership at RBC

 Shape the mandate and culture of a newly formed, high-impact function within RBC's AI Group

 A comprehensive Total Rewards Program including bonuses and flexible benefits, competitive compensation, commissions, and stock options where applicable

 RBC's AI Group is the AI accelerator for RBC, with a focus on driving the shift from early-stage AI projects to scaled, client outcomes that amplify the impact of RBC's people. jobs.title: VP, Finance & Accounting
jobs.description:
Rewind is a service that protects the critical data that powers businesses of all sizes. Our focus is on backing up data that lives in the cloud - in apps like Jira, GitHub, Confluence and Shopify. We are backed by Insight Partners, Inovia, Bessemer and Atlassian Ventures and are proud to be recognized as one of Canada's 50 fastest growing technology companies ( 2023 Deloitte Fast 50 ). We invite you to read our startup story to learn where we came from and where we’re going.
 Read about our mission, story and values here.
To find out more about our perks, click here.
Some of our Blogs might help you get a better understanding of what we do here. You can find them all here.
 Thriving at Rewind: 
 We embrace the fast-paced, ever-changing nature of startup life. If you love working with speed, agility, and creativity, you’ll feel right at home here. Here's what it takes to succeed with us:
 Team-First Mentality: We put teamwork at the core of everything we do, believing that we are better when we are together. Success is shared, and when the team wins, we all win.

 Performance-Driven Mindset: We are proactive, goal-oriented, and focused on delivering tangible, high-quality results. We go beyond meeting expectations - we aim to exceed them.

 Flexible Work-Life Approach: We encourage balance and understand the need to recharge. While we stay agile for urgent needs, we make sure there's time to recover and enjoy life.

 Customer Centricity: Our commitment to customers shapes everything we do. We listen, build relationships, and innovate - from our dedicated customer support team to our engineers, everyone at our company is focused on solving problems that matter most to our users.

 Taking Initiative: We value ownership and proactive problem-solving. We encourage team members to think creatively, take ownership, and lead improvements. Your ideas and actions drive our success.

 We Make Time for Fun: We work hard and make time to enjoy the journey. It’s not just about hitting milestones—it’s about making the experience rewarding along the way.

 About the role 
 We’re looking for a senior finance leader to own and evolve Rewind’s full finance function spanning accounting, financial planning, and controller responsibilities. This role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution: you’ll bring a strong accounting foundation, step confidently into hands-on operational work when needed, and guide the business with clear, data-driven insight.
 This is a hands on builder role. You’ll shape the broader finance strategy, while also performing core Accounting and Controller responsibilities. You should expect to roll up your sleeves and operate as both a leader and an individual contributor, handling everything from Board reporting, to financial modelling, to processing payroll and driving month end close. You’ll partner closely with the executive team, particularly the CEO and CRO to ensure Rewind scales with financial clarity, discipline, and confidence.

 What you’ll do 
 Financial leadership & strategy 
 Own company-wide financial planning, forecasting, and performance tracking, including SaaS metrics and operating models

 Partner with leadership to guide investment decisions, pricing strategy, and growth planning

 Deliver clear, actionable financial insights to executives, board members, and investors

 Support strategic finance work including scenario planning and executive-level analysis.

 Accounting, close operations & compliance 
 Oversee and continuously improve the month-end close process, ensuring accurate and timely reporting across P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow

 Maintain high-quality financial reporting and variance analysis to support decision-making

 Step into hands-on accounting work where needed, ensuring no gaps in execution as the team scales

 Own all core accounting operations, including AP/AR, payroll, treasury, and general ledger management

 Lead audits, tax filings, and compliance across jurisdictions, including SR&ED and international subsidiaries

 Manage equity administration (e.g., Carta), ensuring accurate cap table and regulatory compliance

 Controls, governance & infrastructure 
 Strengthen internal controls and financial processes to safeguard company assets and support scale

 Oversee vendor relationships, banking, insurance programs, and external partners (auditors, consultants)

 Build and evolve systems, tooling, and workflows to improve accuracy, efficiency, and visibility

 Oversee the stock option/equity program and management of the cap table.

 Leverage Agentic AI 
 Use Agentic AI to automate key processes such as: accounts receivable, month-end close, and financial package preparation

 Team leadership & development 
 Lead and mentor the finance and accounting team, setting a high bar for accountability and performance

 Foster a culture of ownership, continuous improvement, and cross-functional collaboration

 What you’ll bring 
 Experience in a venture-backed or scaling SaaS company

 CPA designation (or equivalent) with 10+ years of progressive experience across accounting and finance

 Early-career foundation in accounting (e.g., audit, controllership) with a transition into broader finance leadership

 Experience owning both accounting operations and FP&A in a high-growth SaaS or tech environment

 Strong understanding of SaaS metrics, revenue recognition, and financial best practices

 Proficiency using AI tools to streamline and enhance financial modelling, reporting and workflows

 Comfort operating as a hands-on leader, including stepping into payroll, reporting, or operational tasks when needed

 Proven ability to build, improve, and scale financial processes and systems

 Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex financial data into clear insights

 Experience with modern finance tools (e.g., NetSuite, Salesforce, Stripe, Carta, QuickBooks Online)

 Nice to have 
 Exposure to international finance operations and multi-entity structures

 Experience managing or implementing financial systems and automation initiatives

 Familiarity with BI or dashboarding tools (e.g., Metabase, Looker, Tableau)

 Experience supporting board reporting and investor relations

 Location 
 There is a strong preference for candidates based in Ontario for easier collaboration and occasional in-person meetings in our HQ office (Ottawa).

 Compensation Philosophy 
The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process. 
 In some cases, we’re open to hiring at a higher level for the right person and are committed to paying competitively and fairly.

jobs.title: Head of Toronto AI Center
jobs.description:
Lab Summary: 

 Samsung Research America (SRA) develops next-generation technologies in software, user experience, and services for future products. Headquartered in Silicon Valley with locations across North America, we partner with industry and academia to translate research and innovation into tangible outcomes. We lead in machine intelligence by building AI that is user-centric and physically grounded—AI that understands not just what users want, but their physical context and environment.

 Samsung is uniquely positioned to bring this vision to life through nearly 500 million connected devices we sell annually. Our mission is to holistically integrate AI into connected ecosystems—homes, offices, robotics, and beyond—creating a platform that scales quickly while providing deep contextual understanding and spatial awareness.

   The AI Center in Toronto, Canada plays a pivotal role in developing next-generation software, user experiences, and intelligent services that enrich consumers’ lives. This lab actively contributes to the international research community through publications and presentations at major conferences.

   Areas of Research: 

 Computer Vision

 Contextual/Multi-Modal Modeling

 3D Perception & Scene Understanding

 Inference and Reasoning

 Machine and Deep Learning

 Human Computer Interaction (HCI)

 Natural Language Processing

 Position Summary: 

 Samsung’s AI research team in Toronto is looking for an outstanding and highly self-motivated leader to head the lab. The candidates should have extensive expertise in deep learning, computer vision and physics-based AI.

 The AI research center is a key part of Samsung’s global R&D effort and aims to have direct impact on future Samsung products reaching hundreds of millions of users globally. The candidate will work with a team of research scientists and engineers tackling real-world problems involving Samsung’s Artificial intelligence products. The candidate can also have the opportunity to publish at top-tier conferences in deep learning, computer vision, and language understanding.

 Position Responsibilities: 

 Build, manage, develop, lead, and support the AI research team, with the outcome of high-impact research insights that influence the product roadmap

 Present research findings and insights both within and outside of the company

 Serve as a thought partner with the executive, cross-functional, and line of business leadership teams

 Be an evangelist of research practices throughout the company, influencing partner teams

 Drive innovation programs within the relevant fields of Artificial Intelligence,

 Serve as the external face for the AI Research Lab’s advanced technology capabilities

 Drive key University technology collaboration program to build long term innovation partnerships

 Lead Technology Pathfinding to understand key technology trends and impact for Samsung, to help drive growth and new business opportunities for Samsung

   Required Skills: 

 PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience

 10+ years of post-PhD experience leading advanced AI research.

 Deep expertise in vision and multimodal AI and agentic AI (autonomous agents, reasoning, decision-making), plus strong foundations in computer vision, image/video processing, and generative AI applications.

 Significant experience of publishing relevant peer-reviewed articles on artificial intelligence

 Strong algorithmic problem-solving skills, and the ability to program in C/C++, Python, Java, etc.

 Experience in publishing scientific papers in top quality conferences/journals (CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, AAAI, IJCAI, ACL, SIGGRAPH, CoRL, etc.)

 Experience in DL library such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, etc. with strong hands on experience is required

 Experience working with GPU, parallel programming, and Simulation environments is a plus

 Experience in Android development and graphic rendering is a plus

 Ability to work as a team, motivation for international collaboration, strong communication skills, self-motivated, proactive, flexible and passionate about learning

 Ability to work well in a fast-paced global team environment

 Strong network of relationships with entrepreneurs, VC’s industry executives, and technology thought leaders

 Strong presentation skills and excellent interpersonal skills

 Samsung has a strict policy on trade secrets. In applying to Samsung and progressing through the recruitment process, you must not disclose any trade secrets of a current or previous employer.

 Essential Job Functions 

 This position will be performed in an office setting. The position will require the incumbent to sit and stand at a desk, communicate in person and by telephone, and frequently operate standard office equipment, such as telephones and computers.

 Samsung Research America is committed to complying with all Federal, State and local laws related to the employment of qualified individuals with disabilities. If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request a reasonable accommodation as part of the employment selection process, please contact the recruiter or email sratalent@samsung.com.

 At Samsung, we believe that innovation and growth are driven by an inclusive culture and a diverse workforce. We aim to create a global team where everyone belongs and has equal opportunities, inspiring our talent to be their true selves. Together, we are building a better tomorrow for our customers, partners, and communities.

jobs.title: Enterprise Sales Director
jobs.description:
About us 
 Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.
 We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.
 Our co-founders are Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.
 What you'll do 
 Prospecting & lead generation: Identify and target potential customers through research, networking, and cold calling. Build new relationships with our enterprise customers and prospects to drive revenue, pipeline, and deployment capacity.

 Manage relationships: Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers and stakeholders with our largest customers. Serve as their primary point of contact and exceed their expectations.

 Negotiating & closing complex deal cycles: Lead negotiations with existing and prospective customers, addressing objections and closing deals. Navigate contracts and agreements quickly and effectively, working closely with legal and finance stakeholders.

 Sales strategy & planning: Develop and execute sales strategies to meet or exceed sales targets. Craft tailored sales presentations and proposals that meet our enterprise customers needs. Collaborate with our marketing team to implement effective sales campaigns and presentations.

 Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with our broader GTM team, as well as our product, technical and operations orgs to deliver our industry-leading product.

 Operate as an AI-native seller: Leverage AI tools across the full sales cycle- account research, personalized outreach, call summarization, pipeline forecasting, and deal execution- to automate low-value tasks and reinvest that time into high-value customer relationships, while continuously adopting and experimenting with new tools to work faster and smarter than traditional methods allow.

 What you'll bring 
 6-8 years of experience in an enterprise customer-facing sales role, identifying and closing large accounts.

 Enterprise experience: Experience managing a $1M+ quota and running end-to-end complex 6- and 7-figure ACV deals.

 Strong communication skills: Exceptional verbal and written communication abilities.

 Analytical mindset: Ability to analyze market trends, identify opportunities, and make data-driven decisions.

 Prospecting & lead generation: Proven track record of identifying and targeting potential enterprise clients through research, networking, and cold calling.

 Even better... 
 Industry knowledge: Familiarity with the AI landscape, key players, and emerging trends.

 Our values 
 Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

 Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.

 Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.

 Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

 Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.

 What we offer 
 We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:
 Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

 Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

 Life insurance and disability benefits

 Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

 Parental leave

 Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

 Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized 

 Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most

 Free alphorn lessons

 These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.
 Be you, with us 
 We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world. To do so, it is important to us that the diversity of our employees represents the diversity of our customers. We believe that our work and culture are better when we encourage, support, and respect different skills and experiences represented within our team. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. We strive to evaluate all applicants consistently without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other legally protected class.

jobs.title: Director, Technology & Cyber Control Testing
jobs.description:
You are as unique as your background, experience and point of view. Here, you’ll be encouraged, empowered and challenged to be your best self. You'll work with dynamic colleagues - experts in their fields - who are eager to share their knowledge with you. Your leaders will inspire and help you reach your potential and soar to new heights. Every day, you'll have new and exciting opportunities to make life brighter for our Clients - who are at the heart of everything we do. 

 At Sun Life, we're driven by our Purpose: helping our Clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives. Our values shape how we work: caring, authentic, bold, inspiring, and impactful.

 When you join Sun Life, you'll work with passionate colleagues and empowering leaders who support your growth and celebrate your contributions, so you can make a meaningful difference in our Clients' lives.

 Discover how you can make a difference in the lives of individuals, families and communities around the world.

 Job Description: 

 Role Summary 

 Sun Life is seeking a highly experienced and strategic Director, Technology & Cyber Control Testing to lead the execution and continuous evolution of our first-line Technology & Cyber Control Testing Program.

 Reporting to the AVP, Technology Risk & Compliance, the Director will be responsible for establishing and operating a scalable, risk-based control testing function that provides independent challenge and assurance over the design and operating effectiveness of technology and cyber controls across the Digital Business & Technology Solutions (DBTS) organization.
 This role will play a critical leadership position in advancing Sun Life's technology risk management capabilities and strengthening compliance with regulatory expectations, including OSFI, industry frameworks, and internal policies. The successful candidate will build and lead a team responsible for control testing strategy, methodology execution, testing operations, quality assurance, issue reporting, remediation validation, and continuous improvement.

 What You Will Do?

 Lead the Technology & Cyber Control Testing Program
 Establish and manage an enterprise-scale technology and cyber control testing program across DBTS.

 Develop multi-year testing strategies and annual testing plans aligned to technology, cyber, operational resilience, regulatory, and business risks.

 Maintain the control testing universe and ensure testing coverage is aligned to material risk areas and control requirements.

 Drive risk-based prioritization, scoping, and testing frequency decisions across technology and cyber domains.

 Direct Control Testing Execution
 Oversee the end-to-end lifecycle of control testing activities including planning, execution, review, reporting, and remediation validation.

 Ensure testing is conducted using standardized methodologies, procedures, templates, sampling approaches, and evidence standards.

 Lead teams performing design effectiveness and operating effectiveness assessments.

 Provide oversight for thematic reviews, targeted reviews, process adequacy assessments, and substantive testing activities.

 Ensure testing conclusions are evidence-based, traceable, and defensible.

 Build Scalable Testing Operations
 Develop operating models, workflows, governance processes, tooling, and repositories that enable consistent testing at scale.

 Drive automation opportunities and data-driven approaches to improve testing efficiency and coverage.

 Establish coordinated testing cycles and monitor execution performance against annual plans.

 Manage resource capacity, delivery timelines, and stakeholder engagement across multiple concurrent testing activities.

 Lead Quality Assurance and Program Governance
 Build and oversee a formal quality assurance framework for technology and cyber control testing.

 Establish reviewer standards, calibration programs, testing guidance, and quality metrics.

 Drive consistency in testing execution, evidence assessment, issue classification, and reporting.

 Conduct periodic program reviews to identify opportunities for enhancement and increased maturity.

 Drive Reporting and Management Insights
 Translate testing results into meaningful executive-level insights, trends, and risk intelligence.

 Prepare reporting for senior management, risk committees, executives, regulators, and oversight functions.

 Identify recurring control themes, emerging risks, systemic weaknesses, and root causes.

 Develop actionable recommendations that strengthen the control environment and improve risk outcomes.

 Manage Issues and Remediation
 Oversee identification, assessment, escalation, and tracking of control deficiencies and exceptions.

 Partner with technology, cybersecurity, engineering, and business leaders to drive remediation activities.

 Validate corrective actions and assess remediation effectiveness.

 Monitor recurring issues and ensure lessons learned are integrated into future testing activities.

 Build and Lead a High-Performing Team
 Recruit, develop, coach, and mentor a team of high-performing testing professionals.

 Establish a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, collaboration, and technical excellence.

 Provide career development and technical training across testing, technology risk, cybersecurity, data analytics, and regulatory compliance disciplines.

 Promote consistency in testing practices across all team members.

 What You Will Need to succeed?

 Experience
 10+ years of experience in technology risk, cybersecurity, IT audit, internal controls, operational risk, compliance, assurance, or related disciplines.

 5+ years of experience leading teams within technology risk, cyber risk, IT audit, controls assurance, or testing functions.

 Demonstrated experience building or managing large-scale control testing, assurance, or audit programs.

 Experience working within complex, highly regulated financial services environments.

 Experience interacting with senior executives, regulators, internal audit, and second-line risk functions.

 Technical Expertise

 Strong knowledge of:
 Technology risk management

 Cybersecurity controls and frameworks

 IT general controls (ITGCs)

 Cloud security and technology operations

 Identity and access management

 Change management

 Vulnerability management

 Incident management

 Operational resilience and disaster recovery

 Third-party technology risk management

 Data protection and cyber resilience

 Experience with regulatory and industry frameworks such as:
 OSFI B-13

 OSFI E-21

 NIST Cybersecurity Framework

 COBIT

 ISO 27001

 CIS Controls

 DORA

 SOC reporting and assurance frameworks

 Skills
 Exceptional leadership and people management skills.

 Strong executive communication and presentation capabilities.

 Ability to influence and challenge senior stakeholders constructively.

 Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills.

 Excellent report writing and executive storytelling capabilities.

 Ability to lead large-scale transformation and continuous improvement initiatives.

 Advanced knowledge of testing methodologies, sampling techniques, controls evaluation, and quality assurance practices.

 Preferred Qualifications
 CPA, CIA, CISA, CISSP, CRISC, CISM, CBCP, or equivalent professional designation.

 Experience establishing first-line assurance or control testing functions.

 Experience with data analytics, visualization tools, workflow automation, and GRC platforms.

 Master's degree in Business, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Risk Management, or related discipline.

 Reasons why you should join us under the sun? 
 A competitive salary and bonus program, based on market scale

 A flexible group insurance program starting on your first day of work to meet your needs and those of your family.

 Time off that allows you to focus on the moments that matter most. 20 vacation days per year.

 Our Share Ownership Program gives you the opportunity to invest in Sun Life while benefiting from employer matching contributions.

 We are proud to be included in Great Place to Work's 2025 list of Canada's Best Workplaces.

 A warm, supportive, and inclusive culture

 The Base Pay range is for the primary location for which the job is posted. It may vary depending on the work location of the successful candidate or other factors. In addition to Base Pay, eligible Sun Life employees participate in various incentive plans, payment under which is discretionary and subject to individual and company performance. Certain sales focused roles have sales incentive plans based on individual or group sales results. 

 Diversity and inclusion have always been at the core of our values at Sun Life. A diverse workforce with wide perspectives and creative ideas benefits our Clients, the communities where we operate and all of us as colleagues. We welcome applications from qualified individuals from all backgrounds.

 Persons with disabilities who need accommodation in the application process, or those needing job postings in an alternative format, may e-mail a request to thebrightside@sunlife.com.

 We are proud to be a hybrid organization that offers our employees the choice and flexibility to work from both the office and virtually based on the needs of the business, our Clients and you.

 We may use artificial intelligence to support candidate sourcing, screening, interview scheduling. 

 We thank all applicants for showing an interest in this position. Only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

 Job Description: 

 Transform How Global Transaction Banking Leverages Data, Analytics & AI 

 As the  Director, Data Platform Engineering, you will define and execute the strategy, architecture, and engineering roadmap for the  Global Transaction Banking (GTB) Data Platform. Built on  Databricks, the platform serves as the foundation for next-generation data products, advanced analytics, AI-driven insights, regulatory reporting, and mission-critical transaction banking capabilities.
 You will lead high-performing engineering teams responsible for building secure, scalable, and resilient data solutions while establishing modern engineering practices, platform standards, and delivery excellence across the organization. This role requires a technology leader who combines deep expertise in data engineering and distributed systems with a passion for developing talent, driving innovation, and delivering business outcomes at scale.

 Mandate:  Own the strategy, engineering delivery, and operational excellence of the GTB Data Platform, enabling trusted data, advanced analytics, AI innovation, and next-generation transaction banking capabilities through a modern Databricks-powered ecosystem.

 Key Accountabilities 

 Strategy & Platform Leadership 
 Define and execute the strategic roadmap for the GTB Data Platform, ensuring alignment with business objectives and enterprise technology strategy.
 Lead the evolution of the Databricks platform, establishing a scalable, secure, and resilient foundation for analytics, data products, AI, and operational workloads.
 Drive platform modernization, engineering transformation, automation, and AI-enabled development practices.
 Establish engineering and data architecture standards, governance frameworks, and best practices for data, APIs, integration, and platform services.
 Partner with business, product, architecture, security, infrastructure, and operations leaders to prioritize investments and accelerate business outcomes.

 Engineering & Delivery Leadership 
 Lead multiple engineering teams responsible for data platforms, data products, APIs, streaming services, and cloud-native applications.
 Oversee end-to-end delivery of strategic technology initiatives, ensuring quality, scalability, security, reliability, and operational excellence.
 Provide technical leadership and oversight for architecture, system design, engineering standards, and modernization initiatives.
 Drive engineering excellence through adoption of DevSecOps, CI/CD, automated testing, observability, reliability engineering, and platform engineering practices.
 Act as the senior escalation point for critical engineering, platform, operational, and delivery issues.

 Data & Technology Leadership 
 Champion modern data architecture practices, including data products, event-driven architectures, real-time processing, and distributed computing.
 Ensure effective governance, metadata management, lineage, data quality, and platform observability across the GTB ecosystem.
 Drive adoption of data and AI capabilities that improve operational efficiency, customer outcomes, and business decision-making.
 Promote reuse, standardization, and scalability of platform capabilities across GTB technology domains.

 Financial, Vendor & Governance Management 
 Accountable for platform investment planning, budget management, forecasting, and delivery performance.

jobs.title: VP Technology & Innovation
jobs.description:
Teladoc Health is the global virtual care leader, offering comprehensive virtual care solutions spanning virtual care including primary, mental health, expert medical, devices and licensed platform services. Teladoc Health serves the world's leading insurers, employers, and health systems and helps millions of people around the world resolve their healthcare needs with confidence. Serving over 9 million Canadians, Teladoc Health has been in Canada for more than 20 years and operates in 175 countries world-wide.

 Position Summary 

 The Vice President, Technology and Innovation (“VP”) is responsible for defining and executing Teladoc Health Canada’s technology, product, innovation and cybersecurity strategy. The VP leads the development and delivery of Teladoc Health Canada's digital products and technology ecosystem, including product management, software engineering, enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, data and analytics, technology operations, and innovation. The role is accountable for building a secure, reliable, scalable, and modern technology environment that enables high-quality virtual and hybrid care, an exceptional client, clinician, and patient experience, and operational excellence.

 The VP provides executive leadership for Teladoc Health Canada's digital strategy and multi-year technology roadmap, ensuring technology investments and product capabilities align with Canadian market needs, regulatory requirements, enterprise priorities, and Teladoc Health's global strategy. Working closely with clinical, commercial, operations, legal, privacy, compliance, and global technology leaders, the VP plays a key role in advancing Teladoc Health Canada's enterprise data governance framework and responsible use of data and AI, while delivering technology solutions that drive revenue growth, innovation, quality of care, security, and operational efficiency.

 Essential Duties and Responsibilities 

 Technology Strategy & Delivery 
 Develop and refresh Teladoc Health Canada’s digital strategy and multi-year technology roadmap aligned with organizational strategy and business objectives;

 Provide secure, scalable, resilient and sustainable digital solutions and technology infrastructure that meet Canadian business, market and regulatory requirements;

 Lead the strategy, design, development, delivery, and lifecycle management of Teladoc Health Canada’s technology ecosystem, including enterprise architecture, applications, integrations, infrastructure, and digital platforms;

 Develop and execute Teladoc Health Canada’s cybersecurity strategy, ensuring appropriate security controls, resilience, and cybersecurity risk management across technology platforms and information assets

 Own the budget, portfolio, and project management of digital initiatives and ongoing technology operations, ensuring disciplined prioritization, resource allocation, and value delivery; and

 Develop and manage strategic relationships with technology partners and vendors.

 Product Strategy & Delivery 
 Lead Teladoc Canada’s multi-year product roadmap to enable operational excellence, high-quality clinical care, commercial growth, and exceptional client, clinician and patient experiences;

 Translate market, regulatory, clinical, and operational requirements into innovative digital products;

 Champion user-centred design by incorporating the perspectives of clients, clinicians, patients, and internal users throughout the product lifecycle to deliver intuitive, accessible, and seamless digital experiences; and

 Integrate customer feedback, clinical insights, analytics, and user research into product planning, development and continuous improvement.

 Data, Analytics & AI Enablement 
 Lead the operational implementation of Teladoc Health Canada's enterprise data governance framework, including data architecture, stewardship, quality, metadata, lifecycle management, and data governance technologies, in partnership with the legal, privacy and compliance teams, and business stakeholders.

 Champion enterprise analytics, business intelligence, and AI-enabled capabilities that support operational excellence, clinical quality, innovation, and informed business decision-making.

 Develop and maintain secure, scalable, and reliable data management capabilities that enable high-quality clinical insights, operational intelligence, performance measurement, forecasting, and the responsible use of AI.

 Oversee enterprise data and analytics for the Canadian business, delivering timely, accurate, and actionable insights that support strategic planning, operational performance, and continuous improvement.

 Governance, Risk & Compliance 
 Partner with legal, privacy and compliance teams to ensure technology solutions meet applicable legal, regulatory, contractual, security, and clinical quality requirements, relevant market standards and clinical-quality expectations (e.g., PHIPA, PIPEDA, provincial health and privacy regulations, virtual care standards, responsible AI practices);

 Establish and oversee technology governance, including enterprise architecture, software development lifecycle (SDLC), cybersecurity, and cloud governance frameworks and processes, while partnering with the legal, privacy and compliance teams on enterprise data and AI governance and technology vendor risk management; and

 Identify, assess, and manage technology and cybersecurity risks by implementing appropriate controls, monitoring, and mitigation strategies to support the organization’s enterprise risk management framework, business resilience, audit readiness, and compliance with applicable legal, regulatory, contractual, and organizational requirements.

 Technology Operations & Cybersecurity 
 Ensure reliable, scalable, and secure IT operations that support business continuity, organizational growth, and compliance with applicable organizational, contractual, and regulatory requirements;

 Oversee the performance, availability, and reliability of Teladoc Health Canada’s technology ecosystem through proactive monitoring, incident management, issue triage, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement to prevent recurrence and improve system resilience;

 Provide executive oversight of Teladoc Health Canada's cybersecurity program, including information security operations, vulnerability management, identity and access management, incident response, disaster recovery, business continuity, and continuous enhancement of security controls.

 Lead technology support services for clinicians, clients, and internal users, while coordinating with Global/International teams on shared platforms, infrastructure, devices (e.g., HHS, GSD), escalation management, and operational support.

 People, Culture & Capability Building 
 Build, lead, and develop a high-performing, multidisciplinary technology organization;

 Strengthen organizational capabilities across product management, software engineering, enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, data and AI, cloud and infrastructure, and technology operations;

 Foster a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, accountability, collaboration, security-by-design, and user-centred product development.

 Supervisory Responsibilities 
 Yes

 Salary Range 
 $230,000 to $250,000/year

 Position Type 
 Backfill

 Qualifications Expected for Position 
 Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Health Informatics, Business or related field (advanced degree preferred);

 12+ years of progressive senior leadership experience in technology, product management, digital transformation, and/or data and analytics, within healthcare, virtual/hybrid care, or a highly regulated sector;

 Demonstrated ability to develop and execute technology strategies that align with organizational objectives and deliver measurable business outcomes;

 Deep understanding of cybersecurity, enterprise architecture, cloud technologies, data and analytics, AI, and emerging technology trends;

 Demonstrated experience leading technology modernization, digital transformation, and enterprise technology operations;

 Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, and change leadership skills, with the ability to collaborate with clinical, commercial, operations, legal, privacy, and compliance functions, and global counterparts;

 Demonstrated success leading multi-disciplinary, distributed, and high-performing teams within a complex, multinational corporate structure; and

 Strong strategic planning and execution capabilities, with a proven track record of managing technology portfolios, product roadmaps, budgets, vendors, and delivery outcomes.

 Work Environment 
 ☐ Office ☐ Remote ☒ Hybrid (Office & Remote)

 Travel: up to 10% 
 Travel percentage reflects an estimate and is subject to change dependent on business needs.

 Physical Requirements 
 To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential job duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform essential job functions. Teladoc Health will make reasonable accommodations for the known
 physical or mental limitations of an otherwise qualified individual in line with company policy.

 About Us 
 Teladoc Health is the global virtual care leader, offering the only comprehensive virtual care solution spanning telehealth, expert medical, and licensed platform services. Teladoc Health serves the world's leading insurers, employers, and health systems and helps millions of people around the world resolve
 their healthcare needs with confidence.

 This job description is a general overview of the nature and level of work performed by employees with this job designation. It is not intended to be a comprehensive list of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of this position. Management reserves the right to add, delete, and/or modify any
 of the job duties or requirements at any time. I acknowledge that I have read and understand the above job description. By signing this job description, I understand the duties that are expected of me.

 Why Join Teladoc Health? 

 Impactful, Connected Healthcare: Support millions of Canadians across the country with accessible care within rural regions & provincial health systems, at no cost to patients. 

 Focus on Quality & Safety: Upholding the highest excellence of clinical quality standards is paramount to Teladoc Health. 

 Collaborative, Supportive Network: Our diverse community is dedicated to transforming healthcare in Canada. Be a part of a growing team across Canada, that thrives on engagement, learning and growth. 

 Our Work Truly Matters: Recognized as the world leader in whole-person virtual care, Teladoc Health uses innovative platforms to provide accessible care across the full continuum of care, at every stage in a person’s health journey. 

 Growth and Innovation: We are growing rapidly - Come grow with us and support our expanding mission to make healthcare more accessible. 

 Diversity and Inclusion: At Teladoc Health we believe that personal and professional diversity is the key to innovation. We hire based solely on your strengths and qualifications, and the way in which those strengths can directly contribute to your success in your new position. 

 Teladoc Health Canada, Inc. uses artificial intelligence-assisted tools as part of our recruitment process, including to screen and evaluate candidates. These tools support, but do not replace, human judgment. Our hiring team makes all final decisions.

 At Teladoc Health we thrive on difference and individuality. Teladoc Health is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.
